testcase.name: touching Offline maps shows the offline-maps panel and fires the offline-maps-opened callback
every All row carries its type badge, and each row is its chip's own row with its own controls
Back from a single-type chip returns to All, and Back from All steps to Cartography
the chip row shows All, Finds, Tracks, Waypoints and Offline maps in that order, with counts matching the data, All selected
deleting a waypoint or a region from All is a swipe, with no dialog
touching Tracks shows the recorded-track list and fires the tracks-opened callback
touching a find in All selects the Finds chip and opens its report, and Back goes to the Finds gallery, then All
leaving the Finds chip while editing is an incidental exit
leaving the Finds chip with nothing being edited is not an incidental exit
All shows every committed record grouped by day, days newest first, finds first in their day, then timed records newest first
touching Finds shows the finds gallery
touching Waypoints shows the waypoint list
EDIT_NEW_FIND lands on Finds editing with the Finds chip selected
